_metadata.description: Test Genie unit-phase delegation and the operator inspection UI.

requirements.title: Serve as the Test Genie unit phase provider
requirements.description: Test Genie shells `unit-health validate scenario <name> --json`, maps the shared assessment through maturity metadata into the tests and coverage dimensions, writes a phase pointer with a local maturity summary, and no longer owns an internal unit runner or a separate coverage phase.

validation.notes: Test Genie phase tests ingest a valid assessment, handle failure severity, and prove the removed coverage phase is rejected.

requirements.title: Operator inspection workbench
requirements.description: The UI shows scenario test maturity, next-level blockers, the test plan table, execution results, a coverage dashboard, architecture/quality findings, artifact/log links, and global impact grouping with loading, empty, degraded, running, and failed states.

validation.notes: Component tests cover maturity summary, plan table, coverage dashboard, findings groups, and degraded states.
